instances.claim: This tells me that the work's value and meaning are never fixed but continually redefined over time — stated three times, once in each line, in the same register.
instances.why: All three make the single point 'continually redefined' at the level of the work's abstract status: 17 ('ongoing process of redefinition'), 21 ('indeterminate and continually redefined'), 22 ('unfolds continually'); the shared roots redefinition/redefined and continually/continually mark it. Line 22 at least adds form ('CENTS is a becoming') and the participants who do the redefining, and line 16 already shows the mechanism concretely (decentralized consensus), which leaves 21 as pure synonym and 17 as a general-level echo of the list it follows — keep 22, cut 21, and let 17 go or make it say something 16 does not.
